description: This file contains automated tests for HTTP proxy and tunnel functionalities using the pytest framework. It includes test cases for proxy connections, tunneling, protocol negotiation, connection reuse, and certificate handling, specific to the curl tool and its integration with different proxies and protocols.

classes.name: TestProxy
classes.description: A class encapsulating multiple pytest test methods for testing HTTP proxy, tunnel, and connection reuse functionalities in curl-based HTTP client tests.

methods.name: _class_scope(self, env, httpd, nghttpx_fwd)
methods.description: Pytest fixture for setting up class-wide test environment, such as creating directories and starting necessary services.

methods.name: get_tunnel_proto_used(self, r: ExecResult)
methods.description: Inspect the execution result trace lines to determine which tunnel protocol ('HTTP/1.1' or 'HTTP/2') was negotiated during the connection.

methods.name: test_10_01_proxy_http(self, env: Env, httpd, repeat)
methods.description: Test downloading data via HTTP proxy without tunneling, verifying successful retrieval with status 200.

methods.name: test_10_02_proxys_down(self, env: Env, httpd, proto, repeat)
methods.description: Test downloading via HTTPS proxy with support for HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, skipping if unsupported.

methods.name: test_10_02_proxys_up(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, proto, fname, fcount, repeat)
methods.description: Test uploading data via HTTPS with proxy, including protocol negotiation checks and data integrity.

methods.name: test_10_03_proxytunnel_http(self, env: Env, httpd, repeat)
methods.description: Test downloading over HTTP via HTTP proxy tunnel with no protocol tunneling.

methods.name: test_10_04_proxy_https(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx_fwd, repeat)
methods.description: Test downloading HTTPS data via HTTPS proxy with tunnel support.

methods.name: test_10_05_proxytunnel_http(self, env: Env, httpd, proto, repeat)
methods.description: Test downloading HTTPS data via HTTPS protocol over HTTP tunnel, supporting multiple protocols.

methods.name: test_10_06_proxytunnel_https(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx_fwd, proto, tunnel, repeat)
methods.description: Test downloading HTTPS data via HTTPS protocol with different tunnel protocols ('http/1.1' or 'h2'), verifying negotiation and data correctness.

methods.name: test_10_07_pts_down_small(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx_fwd, proto, tunnel, fname, fcount, repeat)
methods.description: Download many small files over HTTPS with proxy tunnel, validating protocol and data integrity.

methods.name: test_10_08_upload_seq_large(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, proto, tunnel, fname, fcount, repeat)
methods.description: Sequentially upload large data files over HTTPS through proxy tunnel, verifying protocol and response correctness.

methods.name: test_10_09_reuse_ser(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx_fwd, tunnel, repeat)
methods.description: Test connection reuse across multiple requests over HTTPS and HTTP, validating connection count.

methods.name: test_10_10_reuse_proxy(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx_fwd, tunnel, repeat)
methods.description: Test reusing a proxy connection for multiple sequential requests with '--next' argument.

methods.name: test_10_11_noreuse_proxy_https(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx_fwd, tunnel, repeat)
methods.description: Test that different proxy TLS cipher configurations do not reuse connections for HTTPS.

methods.name: test_10_12_noreuse_proxy_http(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx_fwd, tunnel, repeat)
methods.description: Test that different proxy TLS cipher configurations do not reuse connections for HTTP.

methods.name: test_10_13_noreuse_https(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx_fwd, tunnel, repeat)
methods.description: Test that different TLS 1.3 cipher settings prevent connection reuse over HTTPS.

methods.name: test_10_14_proxys_ip_addr(self, env: Env, httpd, proto, repeat)
methods.description: Test downloading via HTTPS proxy using IP address instead of hostname, with certificate verification considerations.
